title: Engineering Knowledge Object -- object.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §4: an Engineering Knowledge Object is a structured collection of Engineering Knowledge Facets, not a file. This file carries the nine facets that are not array-heavy enough to warrant their own sibling file (Identity, Classification, Authority, Evidence, Provenance, History, Simulation, Visualization, Assets); Properties, Relationships, Behaviors, Validation, and Education remain their own files exactly as in WORK_PACKAGE_001, each independently schema'd as its own facet (SDD-R011 §21 rule 3: "Files are implementation details" -- the facet, not the file, is the architectural unit; see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md).
